papers.title: DashAttention: Differentiable and Adaptive Sparse Hierarchical Attention
papers.what: Replaces top-k block selection in sparse attention with differentiable alpha-entmax, achieving full-attention accuracy at 75% sparsity.

papers.title: Post-Trained MoE Can Skip Half Experts via Self-Distillation (ZEDA)
papers.what: Converts static MoE models to dynamic routing post-hoc via self-distillation, skipping up to 50% of experts on easy inputs.

papers.title: Stop When Reasoning Converges: Semantic-Preserving Early Exit for Reasoning Models
papers.what: Detects reasoning convergence via semantic similarity to stop LLM reasoning early without sacrificing accuracy.

papers.title: STARFlow2: Bridging Language Models and Normalizing Flows for Unified Multimodal Generation
papers.what: Unifies text and image generation under one causal mask by replacing diffusion with autoregressive normalizing flows.
